en.title: Angket Bot - Link Checker
en.verdict_dangerous: This link is DANGEROUS - avoid it.
en.verdict_suspicious: This link is SUSPICIOUS - proceed with caution.
en.heads_up: Bot can make mistakes. Please check carefully.
en.reason_abused_tld: Domain ends in .{tld}, a free TLD heavily used for scams.
en.reason_shortener: Shortened link - the real destination is hidden until you click.
en.reason_raw_ip: Uses a raw IP address instead of a domain name.
en.action_dangerous_1: Do not open this link, log in, or enter any codes, passwords, or card details.
en.action_dangerous_2: Block and report the sender - this pattern matches known scam tactics.
en.action_suspicious_1: Don't log in, pay, or enter personal details until you confirm this is legitimate.
en.action_safe_1: No strong scam signals were found, but always double-check before entering sensitive info.
